title: AI-Driven Free Space Optical Communication System
summary: MUST has simulated an optical-communication design while training an AI attenuation model, with hardware integration still planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The project uses climate information to predict free-space optical signal attenuation. MATLAB simulation is complete for the initial design, while the AI model is still being trained and integrated. More resilient and efficient communication is the intended benefit.
purpose: Adapt optical communication to changing atmospheric conditions.
system: AI-Driven Free Space Optical Communication System

ratings.reason: Optical-communication design has only simulation, while AI attenuation-model training and integration remain unfinished.
Resilient smart-city connectivity is a projected effect.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 20: AI-Driven Free Space Optical Communication System

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Weather-aware optical communications remain in simulation
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
